reviewer.capabilityTest: PNG opened with the read tool and described from rendered content before any sidecar was consulted.
reviewer.method: Native-resolution inspection of each PNG plus 3x nearest-neighbour crops of the viewport for gizmo-axis detail. No OCR. On-screen Inspector text read directly.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Translate mode. Cube rotated ~40.88 deg about Y (Quat Y 0.349237, W 0.937034). Position X 0.902087, Y 0.5, Z 0. Gizmo axes green-up, red-lower-right, blue-lower-left - identical to the unrotated translate baseline in sp-05_mode_switch.png, so the gizmo does not inherit the object rotation. Cube displaced along +X. No clipping or rendering artifact.
images.reviewerNotes: World-oriented position gizmo on a rotated object; world-X translation.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Position X unchanged at 0.902087, Y 1.317648, Z 0. Cube visibly higher in the viewport with unchanged orientation. Gizmo remains green-up, red-lower-right, blue-lower-left. No artifact.
images.reviewerNotes: Motion confined to world +Y; world-oriented axes retained.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Position X 0.902087, Y 1.317648, Z 0.858875. Cube displaced with the perspective shift expected for world +Z; rotation and scale rows unchanged. Gizmo remains green-up, red-lower-right, blue-lower-left. No artifact.
images.reviewerNotes: Motion confined to world +Z; world-oriented axes retained.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Rotate mode. Position (0, 0.5, 0); compound rotation Euler X 0.552073, Y 0.876794, Z 0.562393; quaternion VALID. Rotation rings centered on the cube: green ring is a horizontally elongated ellipse (world horizontal plane); red and blue rings are tilted ellipses. Cube shows a compound orientation. No ring distortion, gap, or clipping.
images.reviewerNotes: Ring set is world-aligned and does not inherit the object's compound rotation. Drag path itself is not visible in a still frame; verdict rests on ring orientation plus post-state Inspector.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Scale mode, identity rotation, Scale X 1.214723, Y 1, Z 1. Scale gizmo coincides with world axes (green-up, red-lower-right, blue-lower-left). Cube silhouette slightly elongated along the red axis. No artifact.
images.reviewerNotes: Unrotated baseline: local equals world, as expected.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Rotation ~40.88 deg about Y (Quat Y 0.349237, W 0.937034); Scale X 1.203411, Y 1, Z 1. Scale gizmo visibly rotates with the cube: red points almost horizontally right, blue almost straight down, green up. This differs clearly from the T-03 world baseline. Cube stretched along local X; no distortion of other axes.
images.reviewerNotes: Direct visual proof of local-oriented scaling on a rotated entity.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Rotation ~87.42 deg about Y (Quat Y 0.691189, W 0.722674; Euler Y 1.526265); Scale X 1.203411, Y 1.134295, Z 1. Gizmo red points upper-right, blue lower-right, green up - the expected screen swap of local axes near 90 deg. Coherent cube silhouette, no shear, inversion, collapse, or clipping.
images.reviewerNotes: Local-oriented behaviour remains consistent at a large rotation. Angle is ~87.42 deg, not exactly 90 deg; procedure allows approximately 90 deg.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Status line reads 'T-05 comparison: STABLE'. Translate mode, identity transform (Position 0/0.5/0, identity quaternion, Scale 1/1/1). Quaternion and scale validation both VALID. Clean unrotated cube.
images.reviewerNotes: Object state unchanged across mode switches.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Status 'State captured.'. Scale mode; Position X 0.713283, Y 0.5, Z 0; rotation ~40.88 deg Y; Scale X 1.154594, Y 1, Z 1; quaternion VALID, scale VALID. Single coherent rotated box, straight edges, no shear, inversion, collapse, gap, or clipping.
images.reviewerNotes: Final state is a valid non-uniformly scaled, rotated rigid body.

images.observedVisualEvidence: Rotation ~40.88 deg Y; Scale X 1, Y 1, Z 1.304800. Local-oriented gizmo (red horizontal-right, blue straight-down, green up). Cube visibly elongated along the screen-vertical projection of local +Z, horizontal extent essentially unchanged.
images.reviewerNotes: Supplemental targeted run; clearly labelled, does not replace T-01..T-06 artifacts.
